Author: Rakesh Thapliyal
Bench: Rakesh Thapliyal
 Office Notes,
Sl. Date reports,
No. orders or Court'S Or Judge'S Order

S  proceedings  or directions  and  Registrar's  order with  Signatures  ABA No. 773 of 2025  Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1.
Mr. Divyaman Singh Sen, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Tumul Nainwal, learned A.G.A. and Mr. Chitrarth Kandpal, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. Present applicant Beerbal Singh Yadav @ Veerbal Singh Yadav S/o Ram Singh Yadav is praying for anticipatory bail in relation to FIR dated 13.06.2025, bearing FIR No. 56 of 2025 registered at P.S. Kotwali Almora, District Almora which has been lodged for the offence punishable under Section 420 IPC against the present applicant and two others namely Arun Kumar Shukla and Jaiverr Singh.

entities.text: Beerbal Singh Yadav @ Veerbal Singh Yadav
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: 4. It is contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that by lodging the FIR the complainant questioned the appointment of the petitioner, which was made in the year 1992, i.e. almost 33 years old appointment.
He submits that without holding a preliminary inquiry the FIR has been lodged.
He submits that the applicant rendered more than 33 years of service in the department and retired from service and now the FIR has been lodged that the appointment of the applicant is forged one.

He further submits that co- accused, namely, Arun Kumar Shukla has already been granted interim bail by this Court in ABA No. 766 of 2025.
5.
Learned State Counsel prays for and is granted four weeks' time to file counter affidavit.
Two weeks' time thereafter is granted to the applicant to file rejoinder affidavit.

In the meantime, taking into consideration that in the FIR 33 years old appointment order of the applicant is under investigation and applicant already retired from service, let the investigation may go on

, however, the applicant Beerbal Singh Yadav @ Veerbal Singh Yadav is entitled for interim ABA/773/2025 on 10 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151092789/
1 protection and it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/ Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the investigating agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.

entities.text: Beerbal Singh Yadav @ Veerbal Singh Yadav

He further submits that co- accused, namely, Arun Kumar Shukla has already been granted interim bail by this Court in ABA No. 766 of 2025.
5.
